subject: Maria Nicotra
note: NOT OURS, AND THE MARGIN IS WHAT PROVES IT. The annual index gives exactly one Nicotra Maria in 1875 and this is she. Her marginal annotation reads «Unita in matrimonio con NICITO GIUSEPPE fu Vincenzo con atto del 29.7.91 iscritto in Piedimonte Etneo» -- she married in 1891 and stayed. Ours married SALVATORE MAZZA and died at Brisbane in 1963. So 1875 is eliminated for Maria Concetta Nicotra, and the margin annotation is the test to apply to every other candidate year.

subject: Orazio Mazza
note: NOT OUR HOUSEHOLD, AND THIS IS THE NAMESAKE TRAP AT ITS WORST. A Rosario Mazza whose wife is ALSO a Leonarda -- but LEONARDA MONACORSO, not Leonarda Bonanno -- living in VIA GROTTA NICODEMO, not contrada San Basilio, and given no patronymic where ours is always «di Mariano». The tree's Orazio Mazza is born 1883 to Rosario and Leonarda, so this act is exactly the kind of thing that gets attached to the wrong man. It is not him. TWO MARRIAGES IN THE MARGIN: «unito in matrimonio con CURCURUTO ROSA di Leonardo con atto del 26 Genn.o 905 iscritto in Linguaglossa», and a later stamped ANNOTAZIONE, «ha contratto matrimonio con MANGANO MARIA in Fiumefreddo giusta atto 22-2-1927».

subject: Salvatore Mazza
note: Read at the declaration only (date, declarant, age, occupation, mother, child's name); the street and the witnesses were not read, and the mother's surname reads Fichera? here and plainly Fichera in the 1893 death act. Registered 17 November 1888, the child born at 11.30 in the morning on the 16th; the father is a contadino. Not linked to anyone in this archive: no Venerando Mazza is documented here. The 1887 index also lists a Mazza Salvatore di Venerando (Nati 1887 act 108) and Morti 1887 act 65 lists a Mazza Salvatore of Venerando, which suggests the first Salvatore died and the name was given again; that is an inference from index lines and has not been checked against those acts. The child died on 17 November 1893 at five (Morti 1893 act 144, where the surname is written Marza), so this is the Salvatore of that act. The 1887 Salvatore of Nati 1887 act 108 is a different child: he was born 23 April 1887 to Venerando's first wife and died on 26 June 1887 (Morti 1887 act 65).

subject: Venerando Mazza & Domenica Fichera
note: LINGUAGLOSSA, NOT PIEDIMONTE: Matrimoni 1887 atto 38 of the Linguaglossa register (an_ua81298). Image 22 has a scanner card over the right page, image 23 is the same opening re-shot with the card over the left page, so the act is read from image 23. Checked against the image by the session at the parties paragraph and the witnesses (zoomed), not the whole act. Mazza Venerando, 25 (the two Piedimonte births, April 1887 and November 1888, both give him 26), contadino, BORN AT PIEDIMONTE, resident Linguaglossa, son of Salvatore (resident Linguaglossa, not marked fu) and of Patane Leonarda (resident Linguaglossa). Fichera Domenica, 24, contadina, born and resident Linguaglossa, daughter of Antonio (resident Linguaglossa, not marked fu) and of Toscano Agata (resident Linguaglossa). Married 5 September 1887, 7.30 in the evening, before Mario Vacirca, regio delegato straordinario; publications in August 1887 (the days were not read); witnesses Raciti Marcello and Di Francesco Francesco, both guardie municipali; the spouses declared illiterate. This is his SECOND marriage: the Piedimonte death act of 26 June 1887 (Morti 1887 atto 65) already calls the infant's mother 'fu', so the first wife (Fara? Concetta) died between 23 April and 26 June 1887, about ten weeks before this act. Her own death act is still not found. His parents, Salvatore and Patane Leonarda, appear nowhere else in this archive and nothing here ties them to the Innocenzio or Mariano Mazza households; the Mazza Salvatore, 46, bracciante, who declared the infant's death in June 1887 is not stated to be the father and is NOT assumed to be. The surname is written Mazza in the index and the act.

subject: Venerando Mazza (written Marza)
note: PIEDIMONTE ETNEO, Nati 1861 atto 201 (second volume of 1861, an_ua72407, image 13). THIS IS VENERANDO'S BIRTH. Checked against the image by the session (zoomed on the declaration, the parents' paragraph and the witnesses). Declared on 11 December 1861 by the father, SALVATORE MARZA (as written), 21, bracciale, living at Piedimonte: a baby boy born that day at ten o'clock in the house where they live, to LEONARDA PATANE, 24, living at Piedimonte, and the declarant; named VENERANDO. The parish priest returned the baptism note the same day: 'Venerando Marza'. Witnesses Rosario Greco, 40, bracciale, and Salvatore C... (the surname is not clear), 28, bracciale, both of Piedimonte; the declarant and the witnesses said they could not write. Received by Santo Coglitore (as read), acting assessor standing in for the mayor. No street is given. THE SURNAME IS WRITTEN MARZA throughout (the closing table, the act and the baptism line), the form the 1893 death act of his son also uses; the 1887 Linguaglossa marriage and the Piedimonte births of 1887 and 1888 write Mazza. Ages: the father 21 gives a birth about 1840; the mother 24, about 1837. Venerando was 25 at his marriage in September 1887 and 26 in November 1888, both right for a December 1861 birth. The Mazza Salvatore, 46, bracciante, who declared the infant Salvatore's death at Piedimonte in June 1887 (Morti 1887 atto 65) fits this father by age and trade, but nothing in either act says so: it is a lead, not a finding. Found in the annual table of 1861 line 201 (image 22 of an_ua72407), written Marza; not in the 1862 table. Not read: the rest of the act text outside the parties.

subject: Concetta Faro (wife of Venerando Mazza)
note: Checked against the image by the session (zoomed on the margin heading, the declaration and the parents' paragraph; image 19 is the same opening with the card over the right page, so the act is read from image 20). Atto 39, drawn up at 9.15 on 6 May 1887 before Francesco Mafaraci, acting mayor. Declared by Mazza Salvatore, 46, bracciante, and Pagano Concetta, 37, becchina, both living at Piedimonte; the death was at 5 in the morning of the same day in via Scarella (as read), no house number. FARO CONCETTA, aged twenty, contadina, living at Piedimonte, BORN AT LINGUAGLOSSA, daughter of the late Giovanni and of RAGUSA MARIA, villica (the occupation word is as read), living at Linguaglossa (the clerk crossed out the word 'questo' before it), and 'moglie di Mazza Venerando'. The declarants and the witnesses did not sign. THIS IS VENERANDO'S FIRST WIFE, the mother of the infant Salvatore born 23 April 1887 (Nati 1887 atto 108, where her surname is written Fara) and dead 26 June 1887 (Morti atto 65). She died thirteen days after the birth. The surname is Faro here, in the margin heading and in the annual index (line 'Faro Concetta fu Giovanni, 39', image 77). The Mazza Salvatore, 46, who declared her death is the same man who declared the infant's death seven weeks later; his age and trade fit Venerando's father (Marza Salvatore, 21 in 1861) but no act says so. She was born at Linguaglossa about 1867 to a family already living there, which points to a Linguaglossa marriage with Venerando about 1885-86: the Piedimonte marriage indexes for 1883-86 hold no Mazza groom with a bride of this name. UPDATE 11 Nov 2026: her marriage act is Linguaglossa Matrimoni 1886 atto 45, 24 July 1886 (image 28 of an_ua81297); see the marriage row 1886/45.

subject: Venerando Mazza & Concetta Faro
note: LINGUAGLOSSA, NOT PIEDIMONTE: Matrimoni 1886 atto 45 (an_ua81297). The act is on image 28 (the right page of the opening is atto 46, an unrelated couple). Checked against the image by the session at the parties paragraph and the witnesses (zoomed); the rest of the act was read at register scale. Drawn up at 10 in the morning on 24 July 1886 before Giuseppe Antonio Pafumi (as read), acting mayor. MAZZA VENERANDO, 24, contadino, born at Piedimonte, living at Linguaglossa, son of Salvatore (living at Linguaglossa, not marked fu) and of Patane Leonarda (living at Linguaglossa); FARO CONCETTA, 19, contadina, born and living at Linguaglossa, daughter of the late Giovanni and of Ragusa Maria, living at Linguaglossa. Witnesses Fiorito Raffaele, 37, and Di Francesco Francesco, 34, both guardie municipali (the same two serve at the Linguaglossa marriages of 1886 and 1887). The publications were made on the 4th and the 11th of the same month (July), as read. The groom's parents and the bride's mother gave their consent; the spouses and the consenting parents declared themselves illiterate. Ages: Venerando 24 fits his December 1861 birth (Nati 1861 atto 201) exactly; Concetta 19, then 20 at her death in May 1887, gives a birth about 1867. This is Venerando's FIRST marriage; she died on 6 May 1887, thirteen days after the birth of their son Salvatore, and he married Fichera Domenica on 5 September 1887 (Linguaglossa Matrimoni 1887 atto 38). The surname is written Mazza in the index and the act. Not read: the lines of the 1886 index other than the Mazza lines were not searched for other Faro brides.
